title: Act: Implement the provider factory New
summary: Create provider.go with New selecting by kind
description: Create backend/worker/internal/provider/provider.go with New(kind string, e Exec) (Agent-compatible, error).
acceptance_criteria: New returns Claude for claude and an error for unknown kinds
technical_constraints: Return type is an Agent interface declared in the provider package with the same Run signature as runner.Agent

steps.action: Declare interface Agent with Run(ctx context.Context, workDir string) (float64, error). Declare func New(kind string, e Exec) (Agent, error) with a switch: "mock" returns Mock{}, nil; "claude" returns NewClaude(e); default returns fmt.Errorf with text provider: unknown kind %q.
steps.code: default: return nil, fmt.Errorf("provider: unknown kind %q", kind)
